project.name: FinConsent
project.tagline: Statutory Trade Authorization & Tax-Impact Consent for SEBI RIAs
project.summary: A mobile-first statutory trade authorization and tax-impact consent platform for SEBI-Registered Investment Advisers (RIAs) in India. Dispatches interactive rebalancing proposals with pre-computed STCG/LTCG capital gains and Advance Tax alerts, capturing legally binding, tamper-evident consent via zero-login mobile magic links authenticated by Mobile OTP.

business.problem: Under SEBI Regulation 19, Indian RIAs operate under non-discretionary mandates requiring prior informed client consent and 5-year audit trails. Today, consent is fragmented across WhatsApp/email/phone, clients suffer unanticipated capital gains tax shocks and Section 234B/234C penal interest, and unwieldy 20-page PDFs cause review delays and execution slippage.
business.why_now: SEBI digital compliance inspections have tightened, the restructured Indian capital gains regime (STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5%) increases tax consequences, and inactive compliance leads to license suspension, fines, and client disputes.
goals: Reduce median client consent turnaround from proposal submission to verified authorization from 72 hours down to under 4 hours
Achieve an >88% first-touch completion rate via mobile magic links without dropout
Generate 100% SEBI Regulation 19-compliant PDF dossiers with Section 65B Indian Evidence Act electronic audit metadata within 2 seconds of authorization

success_metrics.how_measured: Timestamp delta from mandate creation to OTP-verified sign-off
Unique magic link visits resulting in verified consent without drop-off

success_metrics.metric: SEBI Regulation 19 audit dossier generation latency
success_metrics.how_measured: Server response and PDF creation time post-authorization

business.business_model: Tiered B2B SaaS subscription in INR + 18% GST: Free sandbox (1 RIA, up to 3 active mandates), Pro RIA (₹2,499/month or ₹24,990/year + GST) with unlimited mandates, 150 clients, custom branding, DLT SMS, and 5-year cloud audit retention, and Multi-Advisor Firm (₹6,999/month + GST) with multi-seat access and compliance officer reviews.

Regulatory validity and audit certifiability prior to production rollout

features.name: RIA Authentication & Session Management
features.description: Email/password authentication with bcrypt hashing and Google OAuth 2.0 session handling.

features.name: RIA Profile & SEBI Credentials
features.description: Configure SEBI Registration Number (INAXXXXXXXXXX), firm identity, and compliance contact email.

features.name: Client Management Directory
features.description: Manage advisory client records including Name, PAN, mobile number, and email address.

features.name: Mandate Builder & Rebalancing Interface
features.description: Define source and target asset allocations (Equity, Debt, Gold, Cash), configure rebalance baskets, and set cutoff expiry window.

features.name: Indian Capital Gains & Advance Tax Engine
features.description: Automated calculation of Equity STCG @ 20%, LTCG @ 12.5% beyond ₹1.25 Lakh exemption, 4% Health & Education cess, and upcoming quarterly Section 234B/234C Advance Tax alert.

features.name: 256-Bit Cryptographic Magic Link Generator
features.description: Generate unique 256-bit cryptographically signed preview URLs with instant revocation and regeneration controls.

features.name: Client Zero-Login Mobile Review Portal
features.description: Responsive single-page mobile interface displaying allocation shift comparisons, sell/buy baskets, and clear rupee tax estimates without requiring client login.

features.name: 6-Digit Mobile OTP Consent & Statutory Verification
features.description: Dispatch 6-digit OTP to client's registered mobile number and verify code upon explicit acceptance of statutory tax and advisory declarations.

features.name: Immutable SHA-256 Tamper-Evident Audit Trail
features.description: Append-only audit record logging client IP, User-Agent, IST timestamp, SHA-256 payload hash, and OTP verification ID.

features.name: SEBI Regulation 19 Compliance Certificate & Dossier
features.description: Instantly generate and export certified SEBI Regulation 19 dossiers with Section 65B IT Act electronic evidence metadata.

features.name: Tiered Subscription & Quota Enforcement
features.description: Enforce 3 active mandates limit on Free tier and provide Razorpay checkout links for Pro RIA upgrade (₹2,499/month + GST).

features.name: Transactional Notifications & Template Dispatch
features.description: Transactional emails via Resend for mandate invitations, approvals, and reminders, plus one-click copyable WhatsApp templates.

features.name: DPDP Act 2023 & Regulatory Legal Disclosures
features.description: Public compliance pages: DPDP 2023 Data Fiduciary Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Razorpay Refund Policy.

nonfunctional.performance: Client Mobile View FCP <= 1.2s and TTI <= 2.0s over throttled 4G; RIA Dashboard loaded in <= 2.5s; route-level code splitting and no external unoptimized assets
security: Validate all inputs server-side with strict schemas
Bcrypt password hashing and secure JWT session tokens
256-bit cryptographically secure pseudorandom magic link tokens
Immutable append-only audit trail with SHA-256 hash chaining
Zero storage or logging of raw card data or banking credentials
Strict CORS and Helmet security headers

never: store or log raw payment cards, CVVs, or net banking passwords
install third-party tracking pixels (Meta Pixel, Google Ads)
allow updating, editing, or deleting committed audit log entries
execute automated trades directly on client brokerage accounts

System flags Advance Tax deadline warning for the upcoming quarterly installment
RIA sets market cutoff time and clicks Dispatch Mandate to generate tokenized 256-bit magic link

journeys.goal: Review trade allocation and tax liability, and provide legally binding consent via OTP on mobile
steps: Client opens finconsent.in/m/{token} on smartphone without logging in
Client reviews allocation shift bars, securities to buy/sell, and estimated tax obligation
Client taps Authorize Rebalance and acknowledges statutory tax and SEBI consent declarations
System sends 6-digit OTP to client registered mobile number
Client inputs OTP and submits verification
Mandate locks as Approved, commits immutable SHA-256 audit record, and generates Regulation 19 compliance dossier
journeys.success: Client reviews proposal on mobile, verifies 6-digit OTP, mandate transitions to Approved & Locked, and SEBI compliance dossier is generated.

acceptance: An RIA can register with email/password or Google OAuth, set their SEBI Registration Number (INAXXXXXXXXXX), and configure client profiles with PAN and mobile numbers.

An RIA can build a portfolio rebalancing mandate that automatically computes estimated Equity STCG (20%) and LTCG (12.5% above ₹1.25 Lakh) in Indian Rupees (₹ Lakhs) and identifies the upcoming Advance Tax deadline.
Clicking Dispatch Mandate generates a secure tokenized magic link with a one-click copy button, opening the client review view without requiring client account creation.
The client review portal loads on throttled 4G mobile connections with First Contentful Paint under 1.2s.
Approving a mandate requires the client to accept statutory disclosures and successfully verify a 6-digit Mobile OTP sent to their registered number.
Submitting the verified OTP immediately transitions the mandate to Approved & Locked, generating a timestamped SEBI Regulation 19 Compliance Certificate.
Every state transition and OTP event is logged in an append-only audit trail with zero UI or API endpoints permitting modification or deletion of records.
Regenerating a mandate link immediately invalidates the prior token and renders an expired link page.
Attempting to create a fourth active mandate on the Free tier is blocked until existing mandates are archived or upgraded.
Baseline Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Refund Policy pages are accessible via the footer, verifying Indian data residency (AWS Mumbai) and showing zero third-party ad tracking scripts.
out_of_scope: Direct automated trade execution on brokerage accounts (preserves strict non-discretionary boundary)
Demat account holding synchronization (no direct CAMS/KFintech/CDSL scrapers)
Portfolio accounting and performance reporting (no NAV or XIRR tracking)
Contractual RIA onboarding agreements (focus is strictly on trade/rebalance consent)
unknowns: Specific production SMS DLT template registration identifiers
Final legal entity registered address for DPDP grievance officer
